title: Change Lifecycle: AFE Communication Interface Change (LTC6811 -> ADI ADES1830)

revision_history.author: system_engineer
revision_history.description: Change lifecycle demo: HSI interface change

trigger.description: LTC6811 entering NRND (Not Recommended for New Designs); migration to ADI ADES1830 required

affected_artifacts: FB2-SYS-HSI-000001 (HSI authority - new interface spec HSI_AFE_SPI_ADI)
FB2-HW-TSR-000002 (new communication integrity spec - SPI/DMA vs isoSPI)
impact_analysis.risk_assessment: Major architecture change: isoSPI (transformer isolated) -> SPI/DMA (direct). Different fault modes, timing, diagnostic coverage. Independent monitor interface may need redesign.

decision.rationale: Obsolescence forces migration. ADI ADES1830 offers integrated balancing, 16 channels, SPI/DMA. Higher integration but loss of transformer isolation. Independent monitor must be redesigned.

suspect_links: FB2-LNK-SAF-000005 (allocation may not hold for new AFE)
FB2-LNK-SAF-000006 (communication integrity link type may change)
FB2-LNK-SAF-000008 (SWR allocation may need new requirements)
required_updates: Update HW TSRs for ADI ADES1830 specs
Create new SW requirements for ADI driver
Create new AFE driver architecture design
Create new verification tests for ADI driver
Redo HW FMEDA for new AFE
reverification_selection: New test: ADI AFE voltage acquisition accuracy
New test: ADI AFE SPI/DMA communication integrity
New test: ADI AFE balancing control

change_summary.description: Migration from LTC6811 (isoSPI) to ADI ADES1830 (SPI/DMA) due to obsolescence
change_summary.safety_impact: Loss of transformer isolation; different fault modes; independent monitor redesign required
change_summary.cost_impact: New slave board spin; new driver development; re-verification
